tonight.headline: The D/ST hole is closed — and it cost priority
body: Bad news first: Marks is not expected to clear the concussion protocol for Thursday and Montgomery is progressing; Jacobs is out and on bye; Golden is on bye. You claimed the Steelers D/ST for the Rams at 02:53 CDMX — the right drop, but a claim in a league where priority never resets.
ESPN projects 127.8 to 117.0 and gives you 55%. KEI returns filled their two byes at 06:11 CDMX (Coleman, Tyson and Etienne in), so 117.0 is their real number. Your lineup is the projection lineup.

case.label: The script that beats you
case.body: Jonah Coleman (19.5) and Parker Washington (15.3) carry KEI; a big Jacksonville day from Washington and Lawrence (18.6) closes a 10.8-point gap on its own (league file).

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Geno Smith ruled out (Wilson's quarterback) or a Thursday surprise in Houston — Taylor plays there first.
